S_lts_harbor_phase_inland.name: Harbor Phase — Inland City
S_lts_harbor_phase_inland.description: Safe, automated, materially stable, socially active coastal city adapted to rising seas. Harbor Phase is viable and pleasant rather than a dystopia; the leads’ restlessness is not a universal condition.
S_lts_harbor_phase_inland.visual_language: gray-blue rain, raised transit, flood-control gates, public-service UI, cafes, markets, playgrounds, commuters and families under practical civic light
S_lts_harbor_phase_inland.story_function: Shows managed adulthood: everything works, nothing demands enough from the characters.
S_lts_harbor_phase_inland.text: Harbor Phase — Inland City — Safe, automated, materially stable, socially active coastal city adapted to rising seas. Harbor Phase is viable and pleasant rather than a dystopia; the leads’ restlessness is not a universal condition. Visual language: gray-blue rain, raised transit, flood-control gates, public-service UI, cafes, markets, playgrounds, commuters and families under practical civic light.

S_lts_harbor_phase.name: Harbor Phase — Civic Systems View
S_lts_harbor_phase.description: Wide civic view of a functioning inland coastal city whose flood adaptation works: transit, homes, freight, shops, public space, and ordinary evening life.
S_lts_harbor_phase.visual_language: gray-blue rain, raised rail, flood-control gates, apartment windows, civic screens, automated vehicles, storefront warmth, wet glass and concrete
S_lts_harbor_phase.story_function: Opening proof that the world did not collapse; it became managed enough to flatten ordinary agency.

Visual language: gray-blue rain, raised rail, flood-control gates, apartment windows, civic screens, automated vehicles, storefront warmth, wet glass and concrete.

S_lts_harbor_phase_transit.name: Harbor Phase — Elevated Transit
S_lts_harbor_phase_transit.description: Raised transit above the floodwall carrying ordinary commuters through a city that has learned to make routine tidal problems manageable.
S_lts_harbor_phase_transit.visual_language: rain-streaked windows, passengers reading and talking, floodwalls below, calm route displays, wet city light
S_lts_harbor_phase_transit.story_function: Frames Matt inside a system that works before he can meaningfully act.
S_lts_harbor_phase_transit.text: Harbor Phase — Elevated Transit — Raised transit above the floodwall carrying ordinary commuters through a city that has learned to make routine tidal problems manageable. Visual language: rain-streaked windows, passengers reading and talking, floodwalls below, calm route displays, wet city light.

S_lts_municipal_control_room.name: Harbor Phase — Municipal Control Room
S_lts_municipal_control_room.description: Quiet infrastructure operations room. Human judgment genuinely matters during storms and failures; on an ordinary shift Matt mostly watches competent systems handle routine work.
S_lts_municipal_control_room.visual_language: blue-gray monitors, drainage maps, drone feeds, rain on glass, staffed but calm workstations
S_lts_municipal_control_room.story_function: Shows Matt's proximity to responsibility without much actual agency.

Visual language: blue-gray monitors, drainage maps, drone feeds, rain on glass, staffed but calm workstations.

S_lts_harbor_phase_walkway.name: Harbor Phase — Managed Walkways
S_lts_harbor_phase_walkway.description: Lively covered public realm where people commute, meet, eat, shop, parent, and make plans. Comfortable civic life is real here.
S_lts_harbor_phase_walkway.visual_language: wet paving, planted walkways, umbrellas, food stalls, families, commuters, warm storefronts and restrained civic lighting
S_lts_harbor_phase_walkway.story_function: Shows the comfort and airlessness of inland life.

S_lts_inland_montage.name: Harbor Phase — Managed Adulthood Montage
S_lts_inland_montage.description: Cross-section of six functioning adult lives that fit differently: technical work, marine repair, risk review, serious physical training, ordinary plans, personal projects, and private routines.
S_lts_inland_montage.visual_language: specific practical interiors, workshops, climbing wall, screens, tools, kitchens, rain outside windows, personal clutter
S_lts_inland_montage.story_function: Introduces the ensemble's ordinary redundancy before the Reach gives them friction.

S_lts_inland_bar.name: Harbor Phase — Inland Bar
S_lts_inland_bar.description: Warm, busy neighborhood bar where the old friend group actually enjoys itself. Their restlessness exists inside a socially alive city, not an empty room.
S_lts_inland_bar.visual_language: warm light against rain, crowded booths, regulars, pints, food, overlapping conversations, polished wet windows
S_lts_inland_bar.story_function: Lets the adult friend-group dynamic emerge before the Reach interrupts it.

S_lts_flats.name: The Flats

S_lts_flats_service_roads.story_function: Shows that the group is not just walking on seabed; they are crossing the remains of planned access into the offshore future.

S_lts_flats_sector_14.visual_language: half-buried sign panels, concrete stubs, old transit markings, black water channels, fog and practical work lights
